### Phase 24: compact per-probe HfMul overlay

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase24-hfmul-overlay/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Replace Phase 23's copy-on-write HfMul retarget (which materialized an
owned copy of a whole group's VarblockDecision vector when any multiplier
moved) with a dense Box<[HfMul]> overlay layered over the shared immutable
decisions. Geometry reads keep using the base decisions; multiplier reads
resolve through hf_mul_at / PlannedVarblockRange. Groups whose multipliers
did not move keep their shared storage untouched, and capturing an anchor
applies the overlay before freezing the base. Also carries the workspace
version bump to 0.3.0. Preserve output bytes, decoder behavior, thread
determinism, and AnchorReuse semantics.
